description: This file defines the PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_EntityParser' responsible for handling functions related to referencing and dereferencing character entities in HTML, including substitution of text and attribute entities, and entity callback processing.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_EntityParser
classes.description: Handles referencing and dereferencing character entities, providing methods for substituting entities in text and attributes, including special and non-special entities.

methods.name: substituteTextEntities
methods.description: Replaces character entities within textual data in an HTML document with their Unicode equivalents.

methods.name: substituteAttrEntities
methods.description: Replaces character entities within attribute contents in an HTML document with their Unicode equivalents.

methods.name: entityCallback
methods.description: Callback function that processes matched entities, converting hexadecimal, decimal, or named entities to their Unicode characters.

methods.name: substituteNonSpecialEntities
methods.description: Replaces non-special character entities with their Unicode equivalents, skipping special entities.

methods.name: nonSpecialEntityCallback
methods.description: Processes matched non-special entities, converting them if not part of the 'big five' entities.

methods.name: substituteSpecialEntities
methods.description: Replaces only the special predefined entities with their Unicode characters.

methods.name: specialEntityCallback
methods.description: Processes matched special entities, converting numeric or named entities to their Unicode equivalents.
